title: Trending Today: Puppy Bowl
main_content:
This weekend is Super Bowl Sunday.

Two teams will play for the championship of American football. The game will be played at Levi’s Stadium, in Santa Clara, California.

But on social media today, tweets and posts were directed at another game – the Puppy Bowl!

The Animal Planet television channel created the Puppy Bowl in 2005. The TV program shows puppies on a small field similar to a football field. The young animals play with a football, and announcers describe their actions, just like in a real American football game. The Puppy Bowl is set to be broadcast on Animal Planet this Sunday.

On Wednesday, Animal Planet announced the starting lineup for the 2016 Puppy Bowl. Fifty puppies will “play” in the game. They are from animal shelters, and are available for adoption. Each one is in need of a good home.
